selection.diff_summary:
Summary: This change adds constant folding support for the AArch64 SVE intrinsic llvm.aarch64.sve.convert.from.svbool when its operand is a null vector, returning a false scalable vector constant. It also splits ConstantFoldCall handling between fixed and scalable vectors and updates canConstantFoldCallTo to recognize the new intrinsic. The patch is accompanied by an InstSimplify constant-propagation test for folding convert.from.svbool(zeroinitializer) to zeroinitializer.
Changed symbols: ConstantFoldScalableVectorCall; ConstantFoldFixedVectorCall; llvm::ConstantFoldCall; llvm::canConstantFoldCallTo; Intrinsic::aarch64_sve_convert_from_svbool; reinterpret_zero
Behavioral change: Scalable-vector intrinsic calls can now be constant-folded separately from fixed-vector calls.; convert.from.svbool with a null operand folds to a false scalable vector constant.; Constant folding eligibility now explicitly includes the AArch64 SVE convert-from-svbool intrinsic.
Assertion or trace link: APFloat; ConstantFold; assertion; getSemantics().isRepresentableBy
Reproducer link: crash at -O1; small C testcase; floating-point constant folding / representability assertion
Pass or subsystem link: llvm/lib/Analysis/ConstantFolding.cpp; InstSimplify; AArch64 SVE intrinsic folding
Causal explanation: This is clearly a constant-folding change, but it targets scalable-vector intrinsic folding for AArch64 SVE and a boolean-vector zero case. The retrieved hunks do not involve APFloat, floating-point semantics, or representability checks, so there is no direct evidence linking it to the APFloat/ConstantFold assertion in the issue beyond the shared subsystem.
Causal confidence: 0.18

Summary: This change updates constant folding semantics for several integer operations and GEPs to return poison instead of undef in cases involving undef or zero operands. It also adjusts InstSimplify tests to expect poison for insertelement and cast-related constant propagation. The patch is about poison/undef semantics in IR constant folding, not floating-point APFloat handling.
Changed symbols: llvm::ConstantFoldBinaryInstruction; llvm::ConstantFoldGetElementPtr; PoisonValue::get; insertelement_undef; overflow_fptosi
Behavioral change: Division and remainder folds now produce poison when the RHS is undef or zero, instead of undef or the LHS.; Inbounds GEP folding now returns poison for invalid base-pointer choices, while non-inbounds retains undef.; Several constant-propagation expectations were updated from undef to poison.

Reproducer link: crash at -O1; small C testcase; floating-point constant folding / representability assertion

top_candidates.subject: [LowerConstantIntrinsics] reuse isManifestLogic from ConstantFolding
top_candidates.diff_summary:
Summary: This commit refactors the notion of a "manifest constant" out of ConstantFolding into Constant::isManifestConstant(), and updates LowerConstantIntrinsics to use that predicate when folding llvm.is.constant. The substantive behavior change is that constant-intrinsic lowering now distinguishes merely-constant operands from constants whose contents are fully manifest, including recursively checking aggregates and constant expressions.
Changed symbols: Constant::isManifestConstant; ConstantFoldScalarCall1; lowerIsConstantIntrinsic; ConstantFolding.cpp; Constants.cpp; LowerConstantIntrinsics
Behavioral change: Replaces a local recursive helper with a shared Constant method for determining whether a constant is fully manifest.; Changes llvm.is.constant lowering from 'operand is any Constant' to 'operand is a Constant and isManifestConstant()'.; Preserves recursive aggregate/constant-expression traversal, but tightens the invariant used by the intrinsic folder.
Assertion or trace link: APFloat; ConstantFold; getSemantics().isRepresentableBy; assertion
Reproducer link: small C testcase crashing at -O1; floating-point constant folding / simplification path
Pass or subsystem link: ConstantFolding; LowerConstantIntrinsics
Causal explanation: The retrieved hunks only touch constant-intrinsic lowering and a helper for manifest-constant detection; they do not modify APFloat conversion, floating-point semantics checks, or EarlyCSE. The change could affect whether some constant expressions are treated as foldable, but there is no direct evidence here that it would trigger or fix the APFloat representability assertion described in the issue.
Causal confidence: 0.18

define i1 @test_various_types(i256 %int, float %float, <2 x i64> %vec, {i32, i32} %struct, [2 x i64] %arr, i64* %ptr) #0 {
; CHECK-LABEL: @test_various_types(
; CHECK-NOT: llvm.is.constant
  %v1 = call i1 @llvm.is.constant.i256(i256 %int)
  %v2 = call i1 @llvm.is.constant.f32(float %float)
  %v3 = call i1 @llvm.is.constant.v2i64(<2 x i64> %vec)
  %v4 = call i1 @llvm.is.constant.sl_i32i32s({i32, i32} %struct)
  %v5 = call i1 @llvm.is.constant.a2i64([2 x i64] %arr)
  %v6 = call i1 @llvm.is.constant.p0i64(i64* %ptr)

  %c1 = call i1 @llvm.is.constant.i256(i256 -1)
  %c2 = call i1 @llvm.is.constant.f32(float 17.0)

  %c4 = call i1 @llvm.is.constant.sl_i32i32s({i32, i32} {i32 -1, i32 32})
  %c5 = call i1 @llvm.is.constant.a2i64([2 x i64] [i64 -1, i64 32])
  %c6 = call i1 @llvm.is.constant.p0i64(i64* inttoptr (i32 42 to i64*))

  %x1 = add i1 %v1, %c1
  %x2 = add i1 %v2, %c2
  %x3 = add i1 %v3, %c3

  ret i1 %res6
}

Summary: This commit extends constant folding for the smul_fix and smul_fix_sat intrinsics to explicitly handle poison and undef operands. It returns poison if either multiplicand is poison, returns zero when an operand is undef, and otherwise performs the existing APInt-based fixed-point computation. New InstSimplify tests cover scalar and vector undef/poison combinations.

Behavioral change: Adds explicit poison propagation for smul_fix/smul_fix_sat constant folding.; Adds explicit undef handling for smul_fix/smul_fix_sat constant folding, folding undef multiplicands to zero.; Broadens accepted constant operands from only ConstantInt to ConstantInt-or-undef for these intrinsics.; Preserves the existing APInt arithmetic path for fully constant inputs.

top_candidates.subject: [APFloat] convertToDouble/Float can work on shorter types
top_candidates.diff_summary:
Summary: This commit extends APFloat conversion helpers so convertToFloat/convertToDouble can accept shorter floating-point semantics such as half and bfloat16, by first checking representability and then converting through the corresponding IEEE semantics. It also broadens constant-folding code paths that previously only handled float/double to use these helpers for shorter FP types.
Changed symbols: llvm::APFloat::convertToDouble; llvm::APFloat::convertToFloat; llvm::fltSemantics::isRepresentableBy; llvm::getValueAsDouble; ConstantFP; ConstantFolding.cpp
Behavioral change: Adds a new representability predicate on floating semantics and uses it to gate conversion from non-IEEE-shorter types to IEEE float/double.; Changes constant-folding logic to treat half/bfloat16/float/double uniformly when extracting a scalar FP value.; Introduces assertions that the source semantics must be representable by IEEE single/double before conversion, making previously implicit assumptions explicit.
Assertion or trace link: APFloat; ConstantFold; getSemantics().isRepresentableBy; assert; Float semantics is not representable by IEEEdouble; Float semantics is not representable by IEEEsingle
Reproducer link: Clang crashes at -O1 on a small testcase involving floating-point constant folding; Issue context points to APFloat/ConstantFold assertion behavior
Pass or subsystem link: llvm/lib/Analysis/ConstantFolding.cpp; llvm/lib/Support/APFloat.cpp; constant folding
Causal explanation: This is plausibly related because it directly changes APFloat conversion and constant-folding behavior in the exact subsystem named by the issue. However, the retrieved hunks show an expansion to support shorter types rather than an obvious bug fix for representability assertions. The new assertions could either prevent the crash by enforcing a precondition or expose the same failure earlier if an unsupported semantics reaches these paths, so the link is suggestive but not definitive.
Causal confidence: 0.74
Build risk: Touches core floating-point conversion code used by many constant-folding paths; Adds new assertions in APFloat conversion routines; Modifies behavior for half/bfloat16/float/double handling in ConstantFolding

top_candidates.subject: [FPEnv] EarlyCSE support for constrained intrinsics, default FP environment edition

top_candidates.diff_summary:
Summary: This commit adjusts SLP vectorizer test expectations for floating-point-to-integer vectorization on x86, reflecting different cost-model decisions for SSE/AVX/AVX512 targets. The retrieved hunks are entirely test updates and do not show production code changes.
Changed symbols: llvm/test/Transforms/SLPVectorizer/X86/fptoui.ll; llvm/test/Transforms/SLPVectorizer/X86/alternate-cast.ll; llvm/test/Transforms/SLPVectorizer/X86/alternate-cast-inseltpoison.ll
Behavioral change: Updates FileCheck prefixes and expected vectorization shapes for fptoui/fptosi mixed-cast patterns.; Changes expected lowering from scalarized sequences to vector loads/casts/shuffles in some cases.; Refines target-specific expectations for AVX512F and related subtargets.
Assertion or trace link: No APFloat, ConstantFold, or representability assertion appears in the visible hunks
Reproducer link: The tests concern SLP vectorization of cast patterns, not a small -O1 crash in constant folding; No evidence of EarlyCSE or APFloat semantics handling is present
Pass or subsystem link: SLPVectorizer; X86 cost model
Causal explanation: The reported bug is about an APFloat/ConstantFold assertion involving representability, with EarlyCSE and constant folding as the implicated subsystems. This commit only changes SLP vectorizer test expectations for x86 floating-point conversion costs. Since the retrieved hunks contain no implementation changes and no constant-folding/APFloat logic, there is no evidence-backed link to the crash.
Causal confidence: 0.05
Build risk: Test-only diff in the retrieved hunks; Touches floating-point cast patterns, but only in vectorizer regression tests; No production code in ConstantFolding/APFloat/EarlyCSE is shown

Behavioral change: Adds coverage asserting that rem-of-mul patterns are preserved or simplified consistently across scalar and vector forms.; Adds a poison expectation for `srem i8 -128, -1`.; Expands test coverage for signed and unsigned remainder simplifications involving `mul` with `nsw`/`nuw` flags.
Assertion or trace link: APFloat; ConstantFold; getSemantics().isRepresentableBy; assertion
Reproducer link: clang crashes at -O1; small C testcase; floating-point constant folding / representability assertion
